picks.title: Nvidia competitor Etched hits $5B valuation, $1B in sales for AI chip
picks.why_it_matters: A startup reaching $1B in contracted revenue for AI inference chips signals massive enterprise demand for Nvidia alternatives, validating the AI infrastructure picks-and-shovels thesis and opening doors for adjacent startups in the AI chip ecosystem.

picks.title: The DeepMind trio who built a poker AI are now making money for quant hedge funds
picks.why_it_matters: Elite AI talent spinning out of DeepMind to build a $500M+ fintech signals continued founder migration from big labs to startups, and validates AI-native approaches to quantitative finance as a fundable category.

picks.title: Arcturus could halve the grid's electrical losses using its nano-infused metals
picks.why_it_matters: With AI data centers straining power grids globally, a deep-tech startup offering 50% reduction in transmission losses addresses a critical infrastructure bottleneck that will only grow as energy demand from AI scales.
